description: Queue a real test send for one saved action_email step in a sequence. Call get_sequence first and pass the target sequence.emails entry's nodeId only when nodeType is action_email; action_ab_test steps are not supported by this tool - inspect variant copy on get_sequence.sequence.emails[].abTest.variants. Accepts 1-10 reviewer email addresses and returns one durable emailSendId per recipient for get_email_send delivery inspection. The sequence is not enabled and no subscribers are enrolled. Each successful call sends another set of test emails.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

customAttributes.description: Optional custom attributes to render the test as, for example {"plan": "pro"}. They override the reviewers' stored attributes for merge tags and block conditions in this test only; no contact is changed. When a reviewer is a stored contact, email, first name, last name and full name keys (firstName, name and similar) come from that contact and are ignored.

nodeId.description: action_email step nodeId from get_sequence. The node must belong to sequenceId. Do not pass an action_ab_test node; inspect its variants on get_sequence.sequence.emails[].abTest.variants.

recipients.description: One to ten internal reviewer email addresses. Duplicate addresses are sent only once.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID containing the saved email step.

name: send_sequence_test_email

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `send_sequence_test_email` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

results.description: Per-recipient test-send results containing recipientEmail, durable emailSendId, and legacy jobId.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.
